traits.label: Creeping dread
traits.description: Fear that accumulates gradually through atmosphere and anticipation.

traits.label: Sustained uncertainty
traits.description: Prolonged uncertainty about threat, truth, or outcome.

traits.label: Found-footage realism
traits.description: A documentary or recorded-media texture that increases perceived realism.

traits.label: Isolation
traits.description: Physical, social, or psychological separation from safety and support.

traits.label: Liminal unease
traits.description: Unease created by transitional, empty, uncanny, or in-between spaces.

traits.label: Occult dread
traits.description: Fear driven by rituals, hidden spiritual systems, curses, or forbidden knowledge.

traits.label: Cosmic dread
traits.description: Fear rooted in human insignificance, incomprehensible forces, or reality destabilization.

traits.label: Folk horror
traits.description: Horror rooted in rural traditions, inherited belief, landscape, and community ritual.

traits.label: Body horror
traits.description: Horror centered on bodily transformation, violation, mutation, or loss of control.

traits.label: Creature feature
traits.description: A central nonhuman creature or monster drives the threat.

traits.label: Home invasion
traits.description: Threat enters or surrounds a private domestic space.

traits.label: Possession
traits.description: A person or place is controlled by a supernatural entity or force.

traits.label: Jump-scare density
traits.description: Frequency and prominence of abrupt shock-based scares.

traits.label: Gore intensity
traits.description: Degree of explicit blood, injury, dismemberment, or viscera.

traits.label: Psychological destabilization
traits.description: Fear created through fractured perception, identity, memory, or sanity.

traits.label: Paranoia
traits.description: Suspicion that people, institutions, or perceptions cannot be trusted.

traits.label: Slow burn
traits.description: Deliberate pacing that accumulates meaning or tension before major payoff.

traits.label: Relentless pacing
traits.description: Sustained forward pressure with little emotional or narrative release.

traits.label: Naturalistic acting
traits.description: Performances designed to feel spontaneous, restrained, and behaviorally real.

traits.label: Minimal dialogue
traits.description: Storytelling relies substantially on image, sound, or behavior rather than speech.

traits.label: Long takes
traits.description: Extended uninterrupted shots are a meaningful part of the film's visual language.

traits.label: Dream logic
traits.description: Events follow associative, symbolic, or subconscious logic rather than strict realism.

traits.label: Nonlinear storytelling
traits.description: Chronology is rearranged, fragmented, recursive, or otherwise nonsequential.

traits.label: Ambiguous ending
traits.description: The ending deliberately leaves central meaning, fact, or outcome unresolved.

traits.label: Bleak ending
traits.description: The conclusion offers little hope, relief, justice, or emotional restoration.

traits.label: Hopeful ending
traits.description: The conclusion preserves meaningful possibility, connection, recovery, or renewal.

traits.label: Practical effects
traits.description: Physical makeup, creatures, miniatures, sets, or in-camera techniques are prominent.

traits.label: Stylized visuals
traits.description: Image design is conspicuously authored, heightened, expressionistic, or artificial.

traits.label: Beautiful cinematography
traits.description: The visual presentation produces a strong aesthetic or compositional response.

traits.label: Sound-driven tension
traits.description: Sound design, silence, music, or offscreen audio materially drives tension.

traits.label: Grief
traits.description: Bereavement, mourning, or the continuing impact of loss is central.

traits.label: Melancholy
traits.description: A sustained reflective sadness with emotional or aesthetic richness.

traits.label: Loneliness
traits.description: The pain, condition, or consequences of emotional disconnection are central.

traits.label: Warmth
traits.description: The film creates emotional safety, tenderness, affection, or humane generosity.

traits.label: Nostalgia
traits.description: Longing for or emotional return to an earlier time, place, or cultural memory.

traits.label: Catharsis
traits.description: The film produces meaningful emotional release after accumulated pressure.

traits.label: Awe
traits.description: A response combining wonder, scale, beauty, terror, or transcendence.

traits.label: Emotional devastation
traits.description: The film creates an unusually intense and lingering painful emotional impact.

traits.label: Identity
traits.description: The construction, instability, concealment, or discovery of self is central.

traits.label: Memory
traits.description: Remembering, forgetting, reconstruction, or unreliable memory is central.

traits.label: Obsession
traits.description: Compulsive fixation drives behavior, deterioration, discovery, or conflict.

traits.label: Family
traits.description: Family bonds, inheritance, obligation, rupture, or reconciliation are central.

traits.label: Sacrifice
traits.description: A character gives up safety, desire, identity, or life for another value.

traits.label: Connection
traits.description: The creation, repair, or loss of meaningful human connection is central.

traits.label: Relationship breakdown
traits.description: A close relationship deteriorates under pressure, incompatibility, betrayal, or grief.

traits.label: Conversation value
traits.description: The film rewards discussion, interpretation, argument, or post-watch analysis.

traits.label: Rewatchability
traits.description: The film invites repeat viewing for comfort, craft, discovery, or pleasure.

traits.label: Full attention
traits.description: The film materially benefits from focused, interruption-free viewing.

traits.label: Background friendly
traits.description: The film remains enjoyable with divided attention or casual viewing.

traits.label: Best watched alone
traits.description: The experience is especially effective, comfortable, or immersive when watched alone.

traits.label: Best watched with friends
traits.description: The experience benefits from a social group, reactions, humor, or shared energy.

traits.label: Late-night fit
traits.description: The film is particularly suited to late-night mood, quiet, darkness, or energy.

traits.label: Autumn vibe
traits.description: The film evokes seasonal textures associated with autumn and Halloween viewing.

traits.label: Comfort watch
traits.description: The film reliably provides familiarity, emotional regulation, or reassuring pleasure.

traits.label: Genuine fear response
traits.description: Daniel explicitly reports being scared, unsettled, or physically affected by fear.

traits.label: Boredom response
traits.description: Daniel explicitly reports disengagement, impatience, or lack of stimulation.

traits.label: Admiration without enjoyment
traits.description: Daniel respects the craft or achievement but did not enjoy the experience.
aliases: respect it but did not like it
admired it more than enjoyed it
